title: Forgot the gift. Wrapped a spoon.
caption: Aquarius forgot the gift, wrapped a spoon, then a pinecone with a bow, then told the truth and rebuilt Grandma's lamp. Best present in the room. What's the best gift you got that wasn't a thing?
